title.zh: 移动硬盘为什么跑不满
title.en: Why a USB Drive Never Hits Its Label

desc.zh: 一块能跑 7 GB/s 的 NVMe 固态装进 USB 硬盘盒，为什么只剩几百 MB/s 到两三 GB/s？包装上的 Gen 2×2、40Gbps 说的是什么？九个可以拖动的模型：USB 2.0 的微帧、从名字到线速、Bulk-Only 的一问一答、UASP 的队列、桥接链条上的瓶颈、发热降速、雷电与 USB4 的 PCIe 隧道、U 盘里的几颗闪存。
desc.en: Why does a 7 GB/s NVMe SSD in a USB enclosure measure a few hundred MB/s to two or three GB/s, and what do “Gen 2×2” and “40Gbps” on the box mean? Nine models you can drag: the USB 2.0 microframe, from a name to the line rate, Bulk-Only’s one-at-a-time exchange, UASP’s queue, the bottleneck along the bridge chain, thermal throttling, the PCIe tunnel of Thunderbolt and USB4, and the few dies inside a flash drive.

title.zh: USB 存储在协议地图上的位置：两段协议和一颗桥接芯片
title.en: Where USB Storage Sits: Two Stacks and a Bridge Chip

desc.zh: 电脑看到的是一个说 SCSI 的 USB 大容量存储设备，盘看到的是说 SATA 或 NVMe 的主机，中间是桥接芯片。
desc.en: The computer sees a USB mass-storage device that speaks SCSI; the drive sees a SATA or NVMe host; a bridge chip sits between them.

USB 硬盘盒里面是什么
电脑怎么识别 U 盘

en: how does a USB external drive work
what is inside a USB drive enclosure

title.zh: USB 由主机调度：微帧与批量传输上限
title.en: USB Is Host-Scheduled: Microframes and the Bulk Ceiling

desc.zh: USB 设备不能主动发数据；USB 2.0 每 125 微秒一个微帧，批量传输最多 53.2 MB/s（规范表 5-10）。
desc.en: USB devices cannot start a transfer; USB 2.0 runs 125 µs microframes and bulk transfers top out at 53.2 MB/s (Table 5-10).

zh: USB 主机控制器怎么调度

title.zh: USB 命名与线速：Gen 1、Gen 2、×2 和编码
title.en: USB Names and Line Rates: Gen 1, Gen 2, ×2 and Encoding

desc.zh: USB 3.0、3.1 Gen 1、3.2 Gen 1 是同一个 5 Gb/s；名字只说线速，扣掉 8b/10b 或 128b/132b 编码、包头和协议才是能用的字节。
desc.en: USB 3.0, 3.1 Gen 1 and 3.2 Gen 1 are the same 5 Gb/s link; the name gives the line rate, and encoding, packet headers and protocol come off before the usable bytes.

zh: USB Gen 1 和 Gen 2 区别

title.zh: Bulk-Only 传输：CBW、数据、CSW，一次一条
title.en: Bulk-Only Transport: CBW, Data, CSW, One at a Time

desc.zh: 31 字节的 CBW 包着一条 SCSI 命令，13 字节的 CSW 回状态；一次只允许一条命令，小块读远低于链路速度。
desc.en: A 31-byte CBW wraps a SCSI command and a 13-byte CSW returns status; only one command is allowed at a time, so small reads fall far below the link rate.

zh: CBW 和 CSW 是什么
U 盘拷小文件为什么慢
USB 存储一次只能一条命令
en: why copying small files to a USB drive is slow

title.zh: UASP：四条管道、标签和 USB 3 的流
title.en: UASP: Four Pipes, Tags and USB 3 Streams

desc.zh: UASP 把命令、状态、读写数据分到四条管道，每条命令带标签，借 USB 3 的流同时挂几十条命令，把等待重叠掉。
desc.en: UASP splits command, status and data onto four pipes and tags each command; with USB 3 streams dozens of commands overlap their waits.

title.zh: 桥接芯片：SCSI 翻译与链条上的瓶颈
title.en: The Bridge Chip: SCSI Translation and the Bottleneck

desc.zh: 桥接芯片把 SCSI 翻成 ATA 或 NVMe；一次拷贝停在盘、桥接下行、USB 链路三段中最窄的那一段。
desc.en: The bridge translates SCSI into ATA or NVMe; a copy runs at the narrowest of the drive, the bridge's downstream lanes and the USB link.

zh: 移动硬盘为什么这么慢
移动固态硬盘为什么达不到标称速度
硬盘盒支持 TRIM 吗
硬盘盒能看 SMART 吗
en: why is my external SSD slow

title.zh: 移动固态的发热降速：集总热容模型
title.en: External SSD Thermal Throttling: A Lumped Thermal Model

desc.zh: 盘和芯片的热从小盒子里散出去，温度按指数逼近 T环境 + R·P；高过保护温度就降速，长拷贝的平均速度跟着掉。
desc.en: Heat from the drive and chip leaves a small box; temperature approaches ambient + R·P exponentially, and above the protection point the drive slows, pulling down the average of a long copy.

zh: 移动固态硬盘发热降速
移动硬盘拷一会就变慢
en: copy speed drops after a few minutes

title.zh: 雷电与 USB4 的 PCIe 隧道：不翻译的路
title.en: PCIe Tunnelling in Thunderbolt and USB4

desc.zh: 雷电和支持 PCIe 隧道的 USB4 把盘直接接到电脑的 NVMe 驱动上，上限是隧道分到的 PCIe 带宽（雷电 4 为 32 Gb/s，雷电 5 为 64 Gb/s）。
desc.en: Thunderbolt and USB4 hosts with PCIe tunnelling connect the drive straight to the NVMe driver; the cap is the PCIe share of the tunnel (32 Gb/s for Thunderbolt 4, 64 Gb/s for Thunderbolt 5).

zh: 雷电硬盘盒和 USB 硬盘盒区别
USB4 硬盘盒为什么有时很慢
雷电 5 移动硬盘多快

title.zh: U 盘和存储卡：几颗闪存与总线
title.en: Flash Drives and Memory Cards: A Few Dies and a Bus

desc.zh: U 盘和存储卡里只有一两颗闪存，写入速度是颗数乘每颗速度，再与总线和协议比谁小。
desc.en: A flash drive or card holds one or two dies; write speed is dies times per-die speed, capped by the bus and protocol.

zh: U 盘写入速度为什么低
SD 卡 UHS-I 和 UHS-II 区别
en: why is my USB flash drive slow

title.zh: USB 与雷电存储的前沿（2026 年 11 月）
title.en: The USB and Thunderbolt Storage Frontier (November 2026)

desc.zh: USB4 2.0 已定 80 Gb/s，雷电 5 的 PCIe 隧道为 64 Gb/s；评测报告的雷电 5 盒子顺序读约 5.4–6.7 GB/s。
desc.en: USB4 2.0 defines 80 Gb/s and Thunderbolt 5 a 64 Gb/s PCIe tunnel; reviewers report Thunderbolt 5 enclosures reading about 5.4–6.7 GB/s.

title.en: Three Questions for a USB Speed Label

desc.zh: 先换算线速并看两头谈成哪档，再找链条上最窄的一段，最后看它走 USB 桥接还是 PCIe 隧道。
desc.en: Convert the name to a line rate and check what both ends negotiate, find the narrowest stage, and ask whether it goes through a USB bridge or a PCIe tunnel.

en: how to read USB speed labels
what to check on a USB enclosure box
